default.reason: Uniform 0.18 mm low-current logic, monitor, bias and control interconnects on the compact board. This retains the native 0.18 mm fabrication minimum; power, ground, CAN bus and converter/clock widths are specified separately.

+3V3.reason: Uniform 0.25 mm logic supply and reference distribution.

BOOST_12V.reason: 0.8 mm reservoir/eFuse power path; 0.25 mm feedback, inhibit and enable-resistor branches (R60, R68, R70).

BOOST_SW.reason: 0.3 mm approach from U8.5 to the 0.5 mm inductor/diode path. A 0.5 mm approach would leave only 0.150 mm to U8.6; required track-to-pad clearance is 0.2 mm.

BOOST_COMP.reason: Uniform short, low-current converter compensation route.

BOOT0.reason: Uniform MCU/service route through the dense programming area.

BUCK_FB.reason: Uniform short, low-current buck feedback route.

BUCK_SW.reason: Uniform 0.4 mm local buck switching route after unnecessary narrowing was removed.

GND.reason: Ground pours carry distributed return current; local signal returns use 0.25 mm, converter return paths use 0.3-0.5 mm. Remaining shared-endpoint changes are within contact copper.

HSE_OUT.reason: Uniform short crystal output pin escape.

NRST.reason: Uniform MCU/service route through the dense programming area.

SENSOR_5V.reason: Uniform 0.5 mm protected 5 V distribution, including the revised U4 output escape. Full output copper drop is checked at 300 mA.

SENSOR_12V.reason: Uniform 0.5 mm protected 12 V distribution, with full output copper drop checked at 300 mA.

STATUS_DATA.reason: Uniform 0.18 mm low-current status data connection.

STATUS_DIN.reason: Uniform 0.18 mm low-current status data connection.

SWCLK.reason: Uniform MCU/service route through the dense programming area.

SWDIO.reason: Uniform MCU/service route through the dense programming area.

UART_RX.reason: Uniform MCU/service route through the dense programming area.

UART_TX.reason: Uniform MCU/service route through the dense programming area.

V5_INTERNAL.reason: 0.8 mm power distribution; 0.25/0.3 mm local control and bypass branches. Full buck-to-boost current/drop is independently checked. Historical 0.48/0.9895 mm widths remain recognized; the width inventory reports actual use.

VIN_FUSED.reason: Uniform widened input-power route; nominal 2 A copper-only drop screened with finite via resistance. Adjacent pads constrain further widening.

VIN_PROT.reason: 0.5 mm protected input trunk expands to 0.8 mm at the local buck input bypass; separate 0.25 mm branch feeds the high-impedance U1.5 enable input.

VIN_RAW.reason: Uniform widened input-power route; nominal 2 A copper-only drop screened with finite via resistance. Adjacent pads constrain further widening.

BUCK_CB.reason: Preserved local buck bootstrap copper width.
